programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: A look at stories surrounding the ghost of 17th-century Edinburgh executioner George Mackenzie that sprung up in 1998 after a homeless man broke into his tomb and fell into an assembly of decomposing corpses. Within weeks, stories of blackouts and inexplicable attacks began to spread, with Edinburgh City Council locking the gates and declaring the area out of bounds for public safety. Jan Andrew Henderson began to chronicle the Mackenzie Poltergeist - only to claim to become a target of its malice

programme.title: Hauntings
programme.desc: A look at a 1958 case in which two women travelled together to a nightclub near Lake Lanier in the US state Georgia, but never returned. Weeks later, reports began of a ghostly figure of woman in a blue dress walking across the lake, while calls for help were heard from the water below, before stories of unexplained drownings emerged. Mysterious deaths at Lake Lanier abound, whilst survivors report the feeling of being pulled into the depths or held beneath by unseen hands.

In this documentary, Ian Schrager, one of the two people behind Studio 54's creation, tells the in-depth story of how one of the world's greatest nightclubs was created

programme.title: Disco: Soundtrack of a Revolution

The programme also traces the genre's legacy, with DJ Frankie Knuckles leaving New York for Chicago, where he remixed disco breaks with R&B to produce a new genre of dance music that became known as house

programme.desc: In Derry-Londonderry, a once divided city comes together for an annual celebration like no other, to share a fascination with ghosts, ghouls and the stuff of nightmares. In 1985, at the height of The Troubles, a Halloween-themed fancy-dress party in a local pub did something remarkable - it united a divided community. Forty years later, the small party that started as a fun distraction has grown into Europe's largest Halloween festival, leaving the entire city spellbound. This programme follows the ordinary people behind the extraordinary spectacle as they create and build the street theatre, costumes and art that bring Derry Halloween to life

And Sarfaraz's brother-in-law, surly Pathan chieftain Javed, is in love with Ruth, even though he's never even talked to her. programme.title: Junoon (1978)
programme.desc: Shyam Benegal's award-winning tale of obsessive love set against the 1857 Indian Mutiny, starring and produced by Shashi Kapoor, and adapted from Ruskin Bond's novella A Flight of Pigeons. After witnessing the death of her father at the hands of Sarfaraz Khan, young British woman Ruth is understandably traumatised. And Sarfaraz's brother-in-law, surly Pathan chieftain Javed, is in love with Ruth, even though he's never even talked to her. Now that the British are in danger from the rebellion, Javed seizes the opportunity to get Ruth and her mother, Miriam, and grandmother under his roof, with the intention of making the object of his obsession his wife. Forgetting the fact that Javed already has a wife, is this really a good basis for a marriage? And will the political forces that swirl around them allow his plan to come to fruition?

programme.title: Secrets of the BBQ Kitchen

programme.title: Mary Berry - Love to Cook
programme.desc: The culinary expert offers tips for beginners, showing how to make recipes that will build confidence in the kitchen, including a Victoria sandwich, a mouthwatering stir fry, an open burger, and a biscuit for first-time bakers. In Newcastle, she meets the Men's Pie Club, a group set up to combat male social isolation and the members impress her with their spiced chicken and apricot tagine pie

programme.title: Mary Berry - Love to Cook
programme.desc: Mary cooks four recipes that prove watching the pennies does not mean having to sacrifice on flavour. They include a crab courgetti spaghetti dish that uses tinned fish at a fraction of the cost of fresh. Plus, a spinach filo swirl demonstrates an inventive way of stretching six sausages to feed the family

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary journeys to some of the places closest to her heart, sharing memories from her past and creating new ones, while inspiring those she meets along the way with delicious recipes. Here Mary works behind the scenes at an Indian wedding, helping the caterers pull-off a huge event that feeds 400 people from morning to night, and adding a recipe of her own to the menu. Blown away by the traditions, customs and vibrancy of the wedding, Mary takes time to reflect on her own special day

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary visits Bristol, the city where she had her first job and where her son William studied at university. While in the city, Mary shares dishes including shakshuka, Tuscan chicken, and pear and blueberry galette. She also samples a Michelin-starred menu and tries her hand at street art

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary prepares tea for the England cricket team at Edgbaston in Birmingham, before stepping onto the crease for a quick coaching session with Jonny Bairstow and Ollie Pope. She then shares more of her favourite recipes, including jumbo lentil rolls and rich 'ultimate' brownies

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary explores the historic Jurassic Coastline, which runs from Devon to Dorset, meeting 21-year-old scallop diver Sam Shuker and talk to the local fisherman harvesting sugar kelp seaweed along the shore. She also has some mouth-watering dishes to share along the way, from a rich and creamy moules mariniere and a fresh nori noodle salad, to chicken, spinach and tomato lasagne, and salted caramel cake

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary heads to a festival set in the grounds of Cornbury Park in Oxfordshire, where performers from theatre, music and art come together - but food takes centre stage. She meets up with old friend, Michelin-starred chef Niklas Ekstedt, who'll be cooking for an intimate crowd of diners who sit around the chef's table and watch him work his magic. Sophie Ellis-Bextor will be opening the main stage and Mary is keen to meet up and share some of her recipes, including Mary's forest bean salad with lemon herb dressing served alongside her celery, blue cheese and sage risotto

programme.title: Mary Berry - Cook & Share
programme.desc: Mary heads to Edinburgh, where she meets runners and their families before the city's marathon, which she has been given the honour of starting. She is joined by her granddaughter Grace, with whom she shares her delicious home-made chocolate rocky road treats, and also visits the Royal Botanic Gardens to meet children from a local school. Inspired by the vegetables growing in the gardens, Mary cooks a fresh pea pesto spaghetti, while other recipes include minted lamb and an eggy bread avocado and ham sandwich

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: The food writer and Great British Bake Off judge is in her own kitchen to give step-by-step instructions for recipes for everyday meals and special occasions. She begins with advice on how to host a traditional tea party, sharing a clever trick for making sandwiches in advance and baking bite-sized scones for a cream tea, while her grand-daughters help her make orange butterfly cakes. Mary also visits a plantation in Cornwall to find out how tea is grown

programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live in volcanic hot spots on the ocean bed, areas that reach temperatures hot enough to melt lead and which may hold the secrets behind all life on Earth. Other strange creatures from the depths of the sea include bone-eating worms, fish that walk rather than swim, and hordes of squid. Plus, footage of sharks in a feeding frenzy over the dead body of a whale and the wildlife of the Midnight Zone in the Pacific, an area that never receives any natural light, forcing creatures to rely on their own bioluminescence

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live on coral reefs, including groupers, small predators that scientists believe are as intelligent as chimpanzees. These creatures have a remarkable aptitude for communication to the point where they can interact with other species including octopi and work together to catch prey. Plus, footage of a vast spawning event involving several different species of fish, coral and invertebrates, and time-lapse photography of coral polyps growing and dying, creating a structure visible from space

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Wildlife that live thousands of kilometres from land, featuring footage of baby turtles using debris as life rafts and whales sharks embarking on lengthy voyages across the Pacific to the point where it is safest to give birth. Special pressure-proof cameras are used to film sperm whales hunting for squid a kilometre beneath the surface and the impact of plastic pollution on the oceans is revealed

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: The first of three programmes about the wildlife, landscape and culture in different areas of the country explores the Sierra Madre mountains, and reveals how this rugged landscape has shaped the nation. This chain of peaks includes several volcanoes and is home to a wide variety of animals, including black bears, monarch butterflies, orchid bees and quetzals. The programme also visits the ruins of an ancient Aztec shrine and the blue agave plant which grows in the mountains is used in making tequila

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: Exploring the forests of the Yucatan Peninsula, which contain the ruins of the Mayan civilisation and a wide range of wildlife, including jaguars, monkeys and tropical birds. The region also holds a secret that is the key to how Mexico's people and animals are able to survive during the country's dry season

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life

programme.sub-title: Three Men, a Woman and a Baby

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Mike approaches Alison to discuss their finances following the loss of their B&B business. However, his wife is preoccupied with plotting revenge on the ghosts for April Fool's Day and recruits a playful Humphrey to execute her plans. Meanwhile, Mike is shocked to find someone from their insurance company on his doorstep - an unannounced visit to check the details of the gatehouse fire. Can Mike convince her that lightning really can strike thrice? Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Simon Farnaby

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: In a bid to make some much-needed money, Alison and Mike consider selling some land. The plan proves far from straight forward however, with Lady Button up in arms at the mere thought of losing some of her beloved estate. Thomas enters a competition that he hopes will finally see him become a published poet, but hearing Lady Button speak so passionately about Button House gives him an idea or two. Pat and Julian get locked in a dispute and it is Robin who offers a surprising pearl of wisdom. Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Simon Farnaby

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Alison and Mike are forced to cosy up to Barclay if their plan to sell some land to the golf consortium is going to work. Alison is involved in a silent negotiation of her own - she has designs on Lady Button's bedroom but can't quite muster the courage to ask her outright if she would consider relocating. The ghosts become fixated on solving the mystery of Kitty's death. Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Martha Howe-Douglas

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: The ghosts are officially bored, and Pat comes up with new entertainment for the gang. Mike and Alison host their international buyer at Button House in order to confirm the land sale, but Mike's antics threaten the whole deal - can he pull it back in time? Humphrey is offered a fresh perspective on his strained marriage and finally learns some French, with a little help from a most unexpected source

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Robin has an epiphany that has a far-reaching impact on the rest of the ghosts, who each struggle to believe his prediction. Alison suggests a spontaneous night out with Mike, but on trying to get the old gang together find only Obi and his new girlfriend Brenda are available. Despite Alison's best efforts, the evening doesn't quite meet expectations and the couple are left pondering how much their lives are changing

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Mike and Alison receive a life-changing offer beyond their wildest dreams. Still reeling from the news, and anxious to discuss it, they are interrupted by a heartbroken Obi, who has been suddenly dumped by a strangely callous Brenda. Alison and Mike agree to reconvene with lists of pros and cons. At first, Obi's romantic woes find a sympathetic ear in eternally lovelorn Thomas, but even he tires of Obi's self-pity. Meanwhile Alison must fend off the Ghosts, desperate to sway her decision

programme.title: Only Fools and Horses

programme.title: Only Fools and Horses

Comedy, starring David Jason, Nicholas Lyndhurst and Tessa Peake-Jones

programme.title: Only Fools and Horses
programme.desc: Del's beloved mum apparently makes contact during a seance at the Nag's Head, inspiring him to visit the doctor to seek treatment for stomach cramps. Comedy, with David Jason, Nicholas Lyndhurst and Buster Merryfield

programme.title: Only Fools and Horses
programme.desc: Del becomes a showbiz entrepreneur after discovering a sensational Tom Jones-style singer at a local club. Comedy, starring David Jason, Nicholas Lyndhurst and Tessa Peake-Jones, with a guest appearance by Philip Pope

programme.title: Only Fools and Horses

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Mike approaches Alison to discuss their finances following the loss of their B&B business. Meanwhile, Mike is shocked to find someone from their insurance company on his doorstep - an unannounced visit to check the details of the gatehouse fire. Can Mike convince her that lightning really can strike thrice? Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Simon Farnaby

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: In a bid to make some much-needed money, Alison and Mike consider selling some land. The plan proves far from straight forward however, with Lady Button up in arms at the mere thought of losing some of her beloved estate. Thomas enters a competition that he hopes will finally see him become a published poet, but hearing Lady Button speak so passionately about Button House gives him an idea or two. Pat and Julian get locked in a dispute and it is Robin who offers a surprising pearl of wisdom. Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Simon Farnaby

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Alison and Mike are forced to cosy up to Barclay if their plan to sell some land to the golf consortium is going to work. Alison is involved in a silent negotiation of her own - she has designs on Lady Button's bedroom but can't quite muster the courage to ask her outright if she would consider relocating. The ghosts become fixated on solving the mystery of Kitty's death. Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Martha Howe-Douglas

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: The ghosts are officially bored, and Pat comes up with new entertainment for the gang. Mike and Alison host their international buyer at Button House in order to confirm the land sale, but Mike's antics threaten the whole deal - can he pull it back in time? programme.title: Ghosts

programme.title: Ghosts

programme.title: The Bill

programme.title: The Bill

programme.title: The Bill

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Terry races to Ramani's house, where an increasingly unbalanced Margaret Barnes is planning to commit suicide - only to be stabbed and critically injured while attempting to wrest a knife from her.
